profile.name: PM100A光功率计
profile.description: Thorlabs PM100A光功率计，用于测量连续光的光功率，并可设置自动量程和测量参考波长以适配不同光源。常用于激光、光纤和通用光学实验中的功率监测与校准。
profile.description_en: The Thorlabs PM100A is an optical power meter used to measure continuous-wave optical power. It supports automatic ranging and measurement reference wavelength setting for different light sources, and is commonly used for power monitoring and calibration in laser, fiber-optic, and general photonics experiments.
